verses.pali: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “A laywoman with ten qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A laywoman with these ten qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A laywoman with ten qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ sagge”.
verses.english: A laywoman with these ten qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
